description: This file defines a parser for assistant text segments, handling tagged content such as <think> and <final> tags, and converting raw strings into structured segments with types like thinking or response.

classes.name: AssistantTextSegment
classes.description: A struct representing a segment of assistant text, with an identifier, type (kind), and text content.

classes.name: AssistantTextParser
classes.description: An enum providing static methods to parse raw strings into segments, identify visible segments, and handle tagged content.

methods.name: segments(from:includeThinking:)
methods.description: Parses raw string input into an array of AssistantTextSegment, optionally including or excluding 'thinking' segments.

methods.name: visibleSegments(from:)
methods.description: Returns segments from raw string excluding 'thinking' segments.

methods.name: hasVisibleContent(in:includeThinking:)
methods.description: Checks if there is visible content in raw string, considering whether to include 'thinking' segments.

methods.name: hasVisibleContent(in:)
methods.description: Checks if there is visible content in raw string, excluding 'thinking' segments.

methods.name: nextTag(in:from:)
methods.description: Finds the next tag (<think>, </think>, <final>, </final>) in the text starting from a given index.

methods.name: findTagStart(tag:closing:in:from:)
methods.description: Finds the start position of a specific tag in the text, considering whether it is a closing tag.

methods.name: isSelfClosingTag(in:tagEnd:)
methods.description: Determines if a tag is self-closing based on the presence of a '/' before the closing '>'.

methods.name: appendSegment(kind:text:to:)
methods.description: Appends a trimmed segment to the segments array if not empty.
